high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a Twitter post by Kiran Bedi (@thekiranbedi). The post was made 22 hours prior to the screenshot being taken. The tweet reads "Mera Bharat, Naya Bharat," which translates to "My India, New India" in English. This phrase is often used to express pride in one's country and a vision for its future. The tweet includes a collage of nine images showcasing various athletes from the Tokyo Olympics 2020. The athletes are seen in different sports, including weightlifting, wrestling, track and field, badminton, boxing, hockey
